about: A chip of BN5's whose code moved into BN6's engine (issue #82's C3): BN5's CanladEX held paralysed (hold: each game's own status step, the same bits in both) at (5,2), MegaMan at (2,2) with a folder of SeaSeed D in both games, BN5's chip 47 by BN5's own code and the registry's 429 by the same code moved (BN5's bomb family 0x12 as BN6's 0x62), the first Custom screen's chip picked and OK, used at t30, its seed's sea (BN5's type 0xA as BN6's 14, xpanels.c's), its sound 0xE1 BN5's copied to slot 0x4B: every difference of BN6's play from BN5's fails it (docs/MULTIROM.md, The chips' code).
